preprocessing: scans/prepare.mjs: the upstream 1K JPG diffuse and nor_gl, 512 px wide, tiled to 1:2 for bark, WebP q85; detail scans are luminance scaled to a linear mean of 0.5

cherry_veneer.author: Jenelle van Heerden
cherry_veneer.preprocessing: Official 1K diffuse and nor_gl JPGs resized to 512 px square. Diffuse contrast tuned with RGB multipliers 2.25 and offsets -310/-245/-185. Vendored WebP q90 diffuse and q83 normal.

rough_wood.author: Rob Tuytel
rough_wood.preprocessing: Official 1K diffuse and OpenGL normal JPGs rotated 90 degrees clockwise to align the grain with the furniture UVs, with normal XY rotated to match. Resized to 512 px square, WebP q84 diffuse and q78 normal.

foliage.preprocessing: scans/prepare.mjs foliage: the 1K diffuse and alpha (Poly Haven model maps) or Color and Opacity (ambientCG 1K-PNG), one alpha island per cut, turned base-down, fitted to a cell, WebP q75 with lossless alpha. ambientCG only where Poly Haven has no such leaf (oak, maple, scale-leaf conifer, dry oak).

toybox.preprocessing: scans/toybox.mjs <dir>: 512 px tileable detail (luminance scaled to a linear mean of 0.5) and a normal map derived from it, WebP q70/q72; backdrops: a 1024 px plate and its mirror, blurred into a 2048x1024 sky panorama, WebP q74
